title: 第595章 棋子炮灰傻子第594章 青衫客
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：傻子的神秘身份第一卷：默认第595章棋子？炮灰？傻子（..la）随着玉珏轻鸣，七道清辉自名字上氤氲而出，如烟似雾，渐渐凝聚成七幅虚影，映照出七座风格迥异的山门景象：晨钟悠远，暮鼓沉沉，天地为之共鸣。
只见冷冰寒孤身立于北境万丈雪崖之巅，手中长剑寒光凛冽，正以风雪淬炼剑意。
沐月则端坐于东海琉璃塔最高层，指尖轻点星盘，推演浩瀚星图，周身环绕着流转的星辰轨迹。
龙青漪身处南疆蛊渊深处，素手抚琴，琴音引动九天雷霆，电光在她周身缠绕如蛇。
柳叶霜独行于西荒古战场废墟之中，手持断戟残刃，以战魂为火，重铸兵锋。
流夙静坐中州书院藏书阁内，焚香研墨，一字一句誊写早已残缺不全的上古典籍。
而青莲，则孑然一身，盘坐于昆仑墟云海之巅，衣袂飘然，指尖捻起一缕即将熄灭的紫电，仿佛在挽留最后一丝天罚之力。
就在此时，七道身影竟同时侧首，目光穿透玉珏所化的清辉屏障，直直望入陈景言眼底，仿佛跨越千山万水、时空阻隔，与他神魂相接。
青衫客神色平静，语气却带着难以言喻的沉重，轻声说道：“她们未曾真正踏入此局，却早已是局中执棋之人。你可曾细看？每一枚玉珏背面，皆浮现出一道尚未落笔的空白天诏——那并非空白，而是天命未显。唯有待七位女子各自证得大道、圆满道果之日，那天诏方会显露出真正的形貌与旨意。”
陈景言喉头一哽，心中骤然翻涌起难以名状的酸楚与不安。
就在这刹那，他忽然瞥见第七枚玉珏背面，那缕原本微弱的紫电竟轻轻颤动，似有回应。
下一瞬，紫电骤然炸裂，化作漫天璀璨星屑，如银河倾泻，又似命运碎片洒落人间。
青衫客凝视着他，继续缓缓道来：“你来自归墟——那并非传说中的世界尽头，而是贯穿所有纪元轮回的脐带，是时间与因果交汇的原点。你无父无母，亦无生养之亲，却以万古孤寂中的一缕不灭光华为胎，以诸天崩毁、万界寂灭后的残烬为壤，孕育出七具不灭道躯。每一具道躯，皆承载着一个纪元毁灭之际最炽烈、最不甘的意志；每一具，都是一道尚未降下的雷霆、一粒尚未点燃的星种、一卷尚未开启的天书——它们沉睡于你体内，只待时机成熟，便将重临世间。”
陈景言听罢，嘴角扯出一抹苦笑，眼中却无半分笑意。
他仰头望向虚空，声音沙哑而直白：“别说那些冠冕，皇的话了。你就直说吧——我不过是你和他们造出来的容器，一个被精心设计的工具罢了。”
青衫客嘴角微微扬起，神情淡然如云，语气平静却带着不容置疑的笃定，缓缓说道：“话不要说得这么难听，这都是宿命使然，你终究逃不过，也唯有认命才是正途。”
陈景言双拳紧握，掌心骨骼因用力过猛而发出咯吱作响的声音，指节因过度紧绷而泛出惨白之色。
他掌中那轮大日轮剧烈跳动，金红色的火星不断迸溅，炽烈的高温将周遭缭绕的云气灼烧得扭曲翻涌，仿佛天地也为之震颤。
“宿命？”他冷笑着，眼中燃起不屈的怒焰，“我偏要逆了这所谓宿命！当年旧天以囚笼困住鸿钧，如今你们又妄图用‘宿命’二字来束缚我，真当我这大日如来掌，斩不开你们披着天意外衣的遮羞布？”
青衫客缓缓抬眼，目光投向天穹之上那片刚刚凝聚而成的新生云霭。

七缕魂息在云层间交织缠绕，织成一张柔和而神圣的光网，映照出某种难以言喻的因果轨迹。
他的声音依旧平缓如初，听不出半分情绪波动，仿佛早已看透一切：“你若真心甘愿做一枚任人摆布的工具，早在千万年前就该沉眠于归墟深处，不会沿着这条命定之路一步步走到今日，更不会在鸿钧心口留下那一丝生机，让他残存的魂魄化作风，默默守护这新天诞生的第一缕晨光。你斩碎旧天，并非为了我们赋予你的所谓使命，而是为了你心中始终牵挂的那七个人，是为了亿万生灵额头上那道被钉了千万年的烙印能够彻底卸下。这条路，从来不是谁为你铺就的，而是你自己一步一脚印，踏着血与火、爱与痛，亲手踩出来的。”
陈景言笑着说道：“所以，我他是专门为你们生的。归墟不是终点，而是他亲手凿开的第一道门缝。门缝之外，是未曾命名的光。我出自归墟，都是你们安排的？”
青衫客未作答。
陈景言知道，他猜对了。
“其实天道没有错，大日如来佛祖没有错，道祖鸿钧也没有错。是你们玩腻了，想换一种玩法，于是亲手把旧棋盘掀翻，把执棋者拉下神坛，再将新规则刻进每一道裂开的天痕里。”
陈景言继续说道：“这局棋，从头到尾，你们输在忘了：傻子记性最差，却偏偏记得最深。说白了，我才是那个真正的傻子，被你们玩弄几千年。”
青衫客只是微微一笑，表示认同。
陈景言感到无限悲哀，那悲哀如寒潮漫过骨髓，却未冻结他眼底跃动的金焰。
他心心念念要推翻的旧世界，不过是人家玩腻了，随手丢弃的旧玩具。
而他耗尽半生劈开的所谓新天，不过是一场精心设计的开幕仪式。
幕布掀开，灯光亮起，照见台下无数张熟悉又陌生的脸：有他亲手救过的凡人，有他以血饲养的妖族，有他曾舍命护住的稚子，也有他焚尽神魂托举过的初生星轨。
佛祖守佛法，道祖守道法，何错之有？错在将众生之命，编入一册不许翻页的经卷；错在以慈悲为锁链，以大道为牢笼，以天命为刑具——众生匍匐于“无错”之名下，竟无人敢质疑这“无错”的根基早已蛀空。
到最后，错的竟然是自己。
棋子？炮灰？傻子？
或许都是。
一世不行，来两世。
死了两个女人，还要让七个接着去赴死，到最后，这只是一场游戏。
可游戏若无输家，谁来替你们尝那万劫不复的苦？..la
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The Fool’s Mysterious Identity Volume 1: Default Chapter 595 Chess Piece? cannon fodder? Idiot (..la) As the jade jade rang softly, seven rays of light came out from the name, like smoke and fog, and gradually condensed into seven shadows, reflecting the scene of seven mountain gates with different styles: the morning bell is distant, the evening drum is heavy, and the heaven and earth resonate with it.
I saw Leng Binghan standing alone on the top of the snowy cliff in the north, with the cold light of the long sword in his hand, tempering the sword's will with the wind and snow.
Mu Yue sat on the highest floor of the East China Sea Glazed Tower, tapping the astrolabe with her fingertips to deduce the vast star map, surrounded by the moving star trails.
Long Qingyi was deep in the Gu Abyss of Southern Xinjiang, playing the piano with her bare hands. The sound of the piano triggered the thunder of the nine heavens, and the lightning twined around her like a snake.
Liu Yeshuang walked alone among the ruins of the ancient battlefield in the Western Wilderness, holding a broken halberd and a broken blade, using the fighting spirit as fire to recast the military edge.
Liusu sat quietly in the library of Zhongzhou Academy, burning incense and studying ink, transcribing ancient ancient books that had long been incomplete, word for word.
Qinglian, on the other hand, was alone, sitting cross-legged on the top of the sea of ​​clouds in the Kunlun Ruins, her clothes fluttering, and her fingertips twisted a wisp of purple electricity that was about to go out, as if she was trying to retain the last trace of the power of heaven's punishment.
At this moment, seven figures turned their heads at the same time, their gazes penetrated the clear barrier formed by Yu Jue, and looked directly into Chen Jingyan's eyes, as if they had transcended thousands of mountains and rivers, time and space barriers, and connected with his soul.
The man in green shirt looked calm, but his tone was indescribably heavy, and he said softly: "They have never really stepped into this game, but they have already been the ones playing chess in the game. Have you ever looked carefully? On the back of each jade, there is a blank heavenly edict that has not yet been written - it is not blank, but the destiny has not yet been revealed. Only when the seven women each attain the Tao and complete the Tao, will the true appearance and purpose of the edict be revealed."
Chen Jingyan had a lump in his throat, and indescribable sorrow and uneasiness suddenly surged in his heart.
At this moment, he suddenly caught a glimpse of the back of the seventh jade. The originally weak purple lightning trembled slightly, seeming to respond.
The next moment, the purple electricity suddenly exploded, turning into bright stardust all over the sky, like the Milky Way pouring down, and like the fragments of fate falling into the world.
The guest in green shirt stared at him and continued to speak slowly: "You come from Guixu - that is not the end of the world in legend, but the umbilical cord that runs through the reincarnation of all eras, and is the origin of the intersection of time and cause and effect. You have no father, no mother, and no relatives to give birth to, but you are conceived with a ray of immortal light in the eternal loneliness, and with the remnant after the collapse of the heavens and the destruction of all worlds. The ashes are the soil, giving birth to seven immortal Tao bodies. Each Tao body carries the most ardent and unwilling will of an era; each one is a thunder that has not yet fallen, a star seed that has not yet been ignited, and a book that has not yet been opened - they are sleeping in your body and will return to the world when the time is right. "
After hearing this, Chen Jingyan had a wry smile on his lips, but there was no smile in his eyes.
He looked up into the void, and his voice was hoarse and straightforward: "Don't talk about those crowns, the emperor. Just say it straight - I am just a container created by you and them, a carefully designed tool."
The corners of Qingshan Ke's mouth were slightly raised, his expression was as calm as a cloud, and his tone was calm but with unquestionable certainty, and he said slowly: "Don't say it so harshly, this is all fate. You can't escape after all, and the only way is to accept your fate."
Chen Jingyan clenched his fists tightly, and the bones in his palms creaked due to excessive force, and his knuckles turned pale from excessive tension.
The big sun disk in his palm was beating violently, golden red sparks were constantly splashing, and the blazing high temperature burned the surrounding clouds into twists and turns, as if the heaven and earth were shaking.
"Fate?" He sneered, with unyielding anger igniting in his eyes, "I have to go against this so-called fate! Back then, the old heaven trapped Hongjun in a cage, and now you are trying to use the word 'fate' to restrain me. Do you really think that I, the Great Sun Tathagata, are in the palm of your hand?, can’t you cut off the fig leaf you are wearing? "
The man in green shirt slowly raised his eyes and cast his gaze on the newly condensed new clouds above the sky.
Seven strands of soul breath intertwined among the clouds, weaving into a soft and sacred network of light, reflecting some indescribable cause and effect trajectory.
His voice was still as calm as before, and there was no trace of any emotion, as if he had already seen through everything: "If you were truly willing to be a tool at the mercy of others, you would have slept in the depths of the ruins tens of millions of years ago, and would not have followed this destined road step by step to this day, nor would you have left a trace of life in Hongjun's heart, letting his remaining soul turn into the wind, silently guarding the first ray of morning light of the birth of the new sky. You smashed the old heaven, not for the so-called mission we gave you, but for the seven people you have always cared about in your heart, and for the brand that has been nailed to the foreheads of hundreds of millions of creatures to be completely removed. This road has never been paved for you by anyone, but you have stepped on it step by step, stepping on blood and fire, love and pain, and stepped on it yourself. "
Chen Jingyan smiled and said, "So, I was born specifically for you. Returning to the ruins is not the end, but the first crack in the door that he opened with his own hands. Beyond the crack of the door is an unnamed light. I came from Guixu, was it all arranged by you? "
The guest in green shirt didn't answer.
Chen Jingyan knew that he was right.
“Actually, there is nothing wrong with the way of heaven, there is nothing wrong with the Tathagata Buddha, and there is nothing wrong with the Taoist ancestor Hongjun. You were tired of playing and wanted to change the way of playing, so you overturned the old chessboard with your own hands, pulled the chess player off the altar, and carved new rules into every crack in the sky. "
Chen Jingyan continued: "In this game of chess, from beginning to end, you lost because you forgot: Fools have the worst memories, but they remember the best. To put it bluntly, I am the real fool who has been played by you for thousands of years. "
The man in green shirt just smiled and expressed his agreement.
Chen Jingyan felt infinite sadness. The sadness spread through his bones like a cold wave, but it did not freeze the golden flames in his eyes.
The old world that he wanted to overthrow was just an old toy that people threw away when they got tired of playing with it.
And the so-called new sky he spent half his life splitting open was just a carefully designed opening ceremony.
The curtain opened and the lights came on, revealing countless familiar and unfamiliar faces in the audience: the mortals he had saved with his own hands, the monsters he had raised with his blood, the children he had risked his life to protect, and the newborn stars he had burned his soul to lift.
The Buddha abides by the Dharma, and the Taoist abides by the Dharma. What's wrong with that? The mistake is to compile the lives of all living beings into a book that cannot be turned. The mistake is to use compassion as a chain, the great road as a cage, and destiny as a torture device - all living beings prostrate themselves under the name of "infallibility", but no one dares to question that the foundation of "infallibility" has long been hollowed out.
In the end, it was myself who was wrong.
Chess piece? Cannon fodder? Fool?
Maybe both.
If one life doesn't work, come two.
Two women died, and seven more were left to die. In the end, it was just a game.
But if there is no loser in the game, who will suffer the eternal suffering for you? ..la
